scientific_limitations: Specific to Haar-random orthogonal planar shadows of a fixed regular tetrahedron in three dimensions.
Exact full CDF is supplied as a convergent elementary one-dimensional quadrature; no elementary antiderivative is claimed.
Sharp endpoint statements are leading-order asymptotics, not finite-threshold error certificates.
Computer checks are corroboration, not infinite proof or independent mathematical validation.
Originality is provisional with a residual risk of overlapping obscure historical projection or Feret-diameter literature.
title: Exact diameter law and opposite endpoint exponents for regular-tetrahedron planar shadows
